title: Demo (hand-written): product review rich in brands and products
text: I bought the Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones at Best Buy in Chicago after my old Bose QC35 died. The battery life is not great, but the noise cancelling is surprisingly good. Sarah at the store recommended them over the Apple AirPods Max. The ear cushions feel cheap and the case is bulky. For $350 I expected better build quality, so I'm returning them to Amazon next week.

title: Demo (hand-written): restaurant review naming chains, people and places
text: Our barista, Marco, made the best latte I have had in Pittsburgh. The pastries were stale and the music was too loud, but the staff were friendly. Honestly it beats Starbucks and Panera for coffee. I tried the Big Mac at the McDonald's across the street afterwards and the fries were cold.
